name: capped-video-mcp
description: Text-, image- and reference-to-video generation (Seedance, Kling, Veo, Wan) via fal/Replicate with hard budget caps and duplicate protection. Bring your own API key.
long_description: Generates videos through fal and Replicate using your own API keys. The server enforces daily and monthly budget caps and a concurrency limit, detects duplicate requests so agent retries are not billed twice, offers a free cost estimate per model, can ask you before expensive generations, and downloads finished videos automatically. Models: seedance-2.5 (Replicate), seedance-2.5-fal, kling-3.0, wan-2.5, veo-3.1-fast, veo-3.1-lite, hailuo-2.3, gemini-omni-1.2-flash, each with an image-to-video variant (-i2v suffix) that animates a local image as the first frame, plus Seedance reference-to-video (seedance-2.5-ref) that combines several local images and audio clips.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Create a video generation job (billed), optionally from a local first-frame image or from reference images and audio. Deduplicates identical requests within 10 minutes.

tools.name: estimate_video
tools.description: Free cost estimate per model for the given duration/resolution/aspect ratio, cheapest first.

tools.name: get_video_status
tools.description: Poll a job; returns the saved file path when finished.

tools.name: preview_video
tools.description: Six frames of a finished video tiled into one image (needs ffmpeg).

tools.name: download_video
tools.description: Retry the download of a finished video.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Today's and this month's spend against the caps.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Allowed models, prices, durations and defaults.

fal_key.title: fal API key
fal_key.description: From fal.ai/dashboard/keys (API scope, not ADMIN). Leave empty if you only use Replicate.

replicate_api_token.title: Replicate API token
replicate_api_token.description: From replicate.com/account/api-tokens. Leave empty if you only use fal.

default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: seedance-2.5, seedance-2.5-fal, kling-3.0, wan-2.5, veo-3.1-fast, veo-3.1-lite, hailuo-2.3 or gemini-omni-1.2-flash

daily_max_usd.title: Daily budget (USD)
daily_max_usd.description: Generations that would push today's estimated spend above this are refused.

monthly_max_usd.title: Monthly budget (USD)
monthly_max_usd.description: Same cap for the calendar month.

confirm_above_usd.title: Confirm above (USD)
confirm_above_usd.description: Ask before any generation estimated at or above this amount. 0 disables.
